choice.ex: (A) included (B) credibility (C) accuracy 근거 ❷❸❻ 해설: (A) ❸ were repeated each time → 포함되었다 / (B) ❻ belief in the truth of the claim went up → 신뢰도 / (C) ❻ Regardless of whether ~ true or false → 정확성. omitted는 '나머지는 한 번만'과 대비가 성립하지 않음, complexity·length는 근거 없음. 요약문 해석: 1977년의 한 연구에서 학생들은 일련의 잡학 진술문이 얼마나 참으로 보이는지를 세 차례 평가했다. 일부 진술문은 매 회차에 (A) 포함되었 고 나머지는 한 번만 등장했다. 놀라운 결과는 진술문의 (B) 신뢰도가 그것의 실제 (C) 정확성과 상관없이 반복될 때마다 올라갔다는 것이다.

repeating some statements made the experiment quicker to finish

choice.ex: 밑줄 해석: 결정적으로, 그 진술문 중 오직 20개만이 매번 반복되었다 (= 반복된 것과 반복되지 않은 것을 비교할 수 있도록 일부만 반 복한 실험 설계). 해설: Crucial y(결정적으로)가 붙은 이유 → 일부만 반복해야 ❹ '반복된 진술문과 반복되지 않은 진술문'의 진실성 평가를 비교할 수 있음. ① 학생들이 너무 피곤해서 매번 60개의 진술문을 모두 평가할 수 없었다 — 실험 설계의 이유를 '피로'로 오독 ② 일부 진술문을 반복한 것은 실험을 더 빨리 끝내게 했다 — 실험 목적과 무관(비교를 위한 설계) ③ 연구자들은 반복 집단에 참인 진술문만 사용했다 — 참·거짓과 상관없이 반복했다는 ❻과 반대 ④ 학생들은 진술문 중 20개만 정확히 기억했다 — repeated를 '기억'으로 오독 ⑤ 일부 진술문만 매 회차에 제시해서 그 평가를 새로운 진술문의 평가와 비교할 수 있었다 — 정답

choice.ex: (A) offsets (B) additional (C) mirrors 근거 ❷❸❺ 해설: (A) ❷ external pressure is balanced by internal pressure → 상쇄하다 / (B) ❸ in addition to atmospheric pressure → 추가적인 / (C) ❺ equal to the pressure applied by the surrounding water → 그대로 반영하다. exceeds는 '느끼지 못한다'의 이유가 될 수 없고, reduced는 ❸과 반 대, ignores는 ❺와 반대. 요약문 해석: 육지에서 우리는 몸에 가해지는 엄청난 기압을 느끼지 못하는데, 우리 몸 안의 압력이 그것을 (A) 상쇄하기 때문이다. 그러나 물속에서 잠수 부는 물로부터 (B) 추가적인 압력을 받으므로, 주변의 압력을 (C) 그대로 반영하는 압력으로 공급되는 공기를 호흡해야 한다.
choice.psg: ❶ The human body on the Earth’s surface experiences constant air pressure equal to 16-18 tons per square meter of its body surface. ❷ However, this pressure is not felt because external pressure is balanced by internal pressure in the lungs and air cavities of the body. ❸ During dives, in addition to atmospheric pressure, the pressure of the water also acts on the human body. ❹ When submerged underwater, to avoid feeling the pressure of the surrounding environment, it is necessary to maintain the condition of equal external and internal pressure. ❺ To achieve this, air or a breathing mixture is supplied to the diver under pressure equal to the pressure applied by the surrounding water. ❻ Water pressure increases proportionally with depth. ❼ It increases by 1 bar for every 10 meters. ❽ It follows that a diver at a depth of 10 meters experiences a pressure of 2 bar, and to stabilize pressure, the supply of a breathing mixture under a pressure of 2 atmospheres is required.

When submerged underwater, to avoid feeling the pressure of the surrounding environment, it is necessary to maintain the condition of equal external and internal pressure. To achieve this, air or a breathing mixture is supplied to the diver under pressure equal to the pressure applied by the surrounding water.
choice.ul: to maintain the condition of equal external and internal pressure.

read.ko: 예를 들어, 화상 회의를 할 때, 사람들은 한 화면에는 협업자의 얼굴을 두고, 동시에 다른 화면에서는 공유 문서를 보고 있을 수 있다.
read.en: For example, when video conferencing, people may have the face of their collaborator on one screen, while looking at a shared document on another.

read.ko: 이 경우, 작업 공간을 보는 것과 동시에 원격 협업자의 많은 의사소통 단서들을 보는 것은 불가능하다.
read.en: In this case, it is impossible to see many of the remote collaborator’s communication cues at the same time as looking at the task space.

read.ko: 그래서, 의사소통 공간과 작업 공간 사이에는 인위적인 갈라진 틈이 존재한다.
read.en: So, there is an artificial seam between the communication space and task space.

read.ko: 이것은 의사소통 모델을 통해 예측될 필요가 있는 원격 의사소통 기술이 미치는 영향의 한 유형이다.
read.en: This is the type of impact of remote communication technology that needs to be predicted through communication models.

read.ko: 1977년, 심리학자 Lynn Hasher와 David Goldstein은 한 그룹의 대학생들에게 60개의 일반 상식과 관련된 잡학적 지식 같은 진술문들이 참인지 거짓인 지를 얼마나 확신하는지 물었다.
read.en: In 1977, psychologists Lynn Hasher and David Goldstein asked a group of college students how certain they were that sixty general-knowledge trivia-like statements were either true or false.

read.ko: 그 학생들은 그 60개의 진술문을 2주 간격으로 세 번 평가하도록 요청받았다.
read.en: The students were asked to evaluate the sixty statements three times, at two-week intervals.

read.ko: 결정적으로, 그 진술문 중 오직 20개만이 매번 반복되었고, 나머지 40개는 새로운 것이었다.
read.en: Crucially, only twenty of the statements were repeated each time; the other forty were new.

read.ko: 그런 다음 그 연구자들은 반복된 진술문과 반복되지 않은 진술문의 ‘진실성 평가’를 비교했다.
read.en: The researchers then compared the ‘truth-ratings’ of the repeated versus non-repeated statements.

read.ko: 그들이 알아낸 것은 놀라웠다.
read.en: What they found was astonishing.

read.ko: 그 진술문이 참이든 거짓이든 상관없이, 그 주장의 진실성에 대한 믿음은 반복의 작용에 따라 올라갔다.
read.en: Regardless of whether the statement was true or false, belief in the truth of the claim went up as a function of repetition.

read.ko: 다시 말해, 여러분이 어떤 진술문을 더 자주 들을수록, 그것은 더 ‘참인’ 것처럼 들린다.
read.en: In other words, the more often you hear a statement, the more ‘true’ it sounds.

read.ko: 이것은 진실 착각 효과로 알려지게 되었다.
read.en: This became known as the illusory truth effect.

read.ko: 지구 표면 위에서의 인체는 신체 표면 1제곱미터당 16에서 18톤에 달하는 일정한 기압을 겪는다.
read.en: The human body on the Earth’s surface experiences constant air pressure equal to 16-18 tons per square meter of its body surface.

read.ko: 하지만 이러한 압력은 외부 압력이 신체의 폐와 공기가 들어 있는 공간의 내부 압력과 균형이 맞춰지기 때문에 느껴지지 않는다.
read.en: However, this pressure is not felt because external pressure is balanced by internal pressure in the lungs and air cavities of the body.

read.ko: 잠수하는 동안에는 대기압 외에 물의 압력 또한 인체에 영향을 준다.
read.en: During dives, in addition to atmospheric pressure, the pressure of the water also acts on the human body.

read.ko: 물속에 잠겼을 때, 주변 환경의 압력을 느끼는 것을 피하기 위해 동일한 외부와 내부 압력 상태를 유지하는 것이 필요하다.
read.en: When submerged underwater, to avoid feeling the pressure of the surrounding environment, it is necessary to maintain the condition of equal external and internal pressure.

read.ko: 이를 달성하기 위해 공기 또는 호흡용 혼합물이 주변의 물에 의해 가해지는 압력과 동일한 압력으로 잠수부에게 제공된다.
read.en: To achieve this, air or a breathing mixture is supplied to the diver under pressure equal to the pressure applied by the surrounding water.

read.ko: 수압은 깊이에 비례하여 증가한다.
read.en: Water pressure increases proportionally with depth.

read.ko: 그것은 10미터마다 1바씩 증가한다.
read.en: It increases by 1 bar for every 10 meters.

read.ko: 당연히 10미터 깊이에 있는 잠수부는 2바의 압력을 겪고, 압력을 맞추기 위해서는 2기압의 호흡용 혼합물의 제공이 요구된다.
read.en: It follows that a diver at a depth of 10 meters experiences a pressure of 2 bar, and to stabilize pressure, the supply of a breathing mixture under a pressure of 2 atmospheres is required.

read.ko: 연구자들은 포식자들로부터의 큰 위협 없이 평화로운 지역에 사는 미역취들이, 공격받는 드문 경우에, 그들의 가까운 친족만 이해할 수 있는 매우 독특한 화학적 비상 신호를 내보낸다는 것을 최근에 발견했다.
read.en: Researchers recently found that goldenrods that live in peaceful areas without much threat from predators will issue chemical alarm calls that are incredibly specific — comprehensible only to their close kin — on the rare occasion they are attacked.

read.ko: 하지만 더 적대적인 지역에 있는 미역취들은 그들의 생물학적 친족뿐만 아니라 그 지역에 있는 모든 미역취에 의해 쉽게 이해되는 화학적 표현을 사용하여 그들의 이웃들에게 신호를 보낸다.
read.en: But goldenrods in more hostile territory signal to their neighbors using chemical phrases easily understood by all the goldenrod in the area, not just their biological kin.

read.ko: 암호화된 속삭이는 네트워크를 사용하는 대신에 이 미역취는 말하자면 확성기를 통해서 위협을 널리 알린다.
read.en: Instead of using coded whisper networks, these goldenrod broadcast the threat over loudspeaker, so to speak.

read.ko: 그것은 이러한 화학적 교신들이 그것들을 받는 식물뿐만 아니라 보내는 식물에게도 이롭다는 것을 확인한 첫 연구이다.
read.en: It is the first time research has confirmed that these chemical communications are beneficial not only to the plant receiving them but also to the sender.

read.ko: 정말로 힘든 시기에는, 여러분은 들판에 혼자 서 있는 채로 남겨지길 원하지 않는다.
read.en: When times are truly tough, you do not want to be left standing in a field alone.

read.ko: 짝짓기할 상대도, 꽃가루 매개자를 불러들이는 것을 도와줄 상대도 없을 것이다.
read.en: There will be no one to mate with, no one to help bring in pollinators.

read.ko: 무한 스크롤, 자동 재생 영상, 혹은 단지 구매를 하기 위해 계정을 요구하는 것과 같은 패턴들은 모두 사용자들이 자기 자신의 경험을 통제하는 것을 방해 한다.
read.en: Patterns such as infinite scroll, autoplaying videos, or requiring an account just to make a purchase all interfere with the user’s control over their own experience.

read.ko: 지속가능성의 관점에서 이러한 패턴들 중 많은 것들이 데이터와 주의력의 과잉 소비를 부추긴다.
read.en: From a sustainability perspective, many of these patterns encourage overconsumption of data and attention.

read.ko: 무한 스크롤은 사용자가 그것을 원하든 원하지 않든 새로운 콘텐츠를 계속해서 로딩하고, 이는 데이터 사용과 기기의 처리 작업을 증가시킨다.
read.en: Infinite scroll keeps loading new content whether the user wants it or not, increasing data usage and device processing.

read.ko: 자동 재생은 매체가 그것을 절대 시청하지 않을 사람들에게조차도 로딩하고 재생하도록 강요한다.
read.en: Autoplay forces media to load and play even for people who may never watch it.

read.ko: 이러한 선택들은 사용자의 기기와 콘텐츠를 전달하는 서버 모두에서 더 많은 에너지를 소비한다.
read.en: These choices consume more energy on both the user’s device and the servers delivering the content.

read.ko: 한 인기 음악 스트리밍 플랫폼이 기본값으로 정적인 앨범 표지를 짧은 영상의 반복으로 대체하기로 한 결정을 예로 들어 보자.
read.en: Take the decision by a popular music streaming platform to replace static album artwork with short video loops by default.

read.ko: 이러한 변화는 데이터 사용과 배터리 소비를 상당히 증가시키는 반면, 그것을 비활성화하는 선택은 설정 메뉴 속 깊이 숨겨져 있다.
read.en: This change significantly increases data usage and battery consumption, while the option to disable it is buried deep in the settings.

read.ko: 그 결과 대부분의 사용자들은 적극적으로 빠져나올 방법을 찾지 않으면 더 많은 자원을 소비한다.
read.en: As a result, most users consume more resources unless they actively search for a way to opt out.

read.ko: 웹 디자인이 항상 어떤 방식으로든 행동을 유도한다는 것을 인정하는 것은 중요하다.
read.en: It is important to acknowledge that web design always nudges behavior in some way.

read.ko: 결과를 보여 주는 것과 선택지를 강조하는 것은 모두 영향력의 형태이다.
read.en: Showing consequences and highlighting options are all forms of influence.

read.ko: 윤리적 기준은 행동 유도가 존재하느냐가 아니라, 그것이 투명하고, 되돌릴 수 있으며, 사용자의 이익과 일치하는지이다.
read.en: The ethical line is not whether nudging exists, but whether it is transparent, reversible, and aligned with the user’s interests.

read.ko: 많은 경우, 가장 책임 있는 접근 방법은 대안들을 분명하게 이용할 수 있도록 유지하면서 (환경에 미치는) 영향이 더 적은 선택지를 기본값으로 만드는 것 이다.
read.en: In many cases, the most responsible approach is to make the lower-impact option the default, while keeping alternatives clearly available.

read.ko: 기본값들은 영향력이 크고, 신중하게 선택될 경우 사용자 주체성을 없애지 않으면서 환경적 영향을 줄일 수 있다.
read.en: Defaults are powerful, and when chosen carefully, they can reduce environmental impact without removing user agency.

para.en: All sound begins with some kind of motion, something that disturbs molecules in air, water, steel, wood, or other medium. Isaac Newton noted that light waves are colorless; the perception of color only occurs in the brain of a living organism. The same is true of sound. Thus perception of sound begins at our eardrums — before it hits our eardrums, it is nothing more than the disturbance of molecules. We can measure that disturbance with gauges and instruments, but until it hits a brain, it is not sound. You may have heard the old philosophical riddle, “If a tree falls in the forest and no one is there to hear it, does it make it sound?” No, because sound is a psychological concept, a product of brains. That tree will disturb molecules and make a mess, but if no creature hears it, no bird, fox, or human, it has not made sound.

When people are collaborating face to face they can easily see each other and the range of different communication cues being used, so the task space is a subset of the communication space. Ishii, a professor at the MIT Media Lab, describes this as seamless communication because there is no functional separation between the task and communication space. However, when people are working remotely, the task space is often separated from the communication space. For example, when video conferencing, people may have the face of their collaborator on one screen, while looking at a shared document on another. In this case, it is impossible to see many of the remote collaborator’s communication cues at the same time as looking at the task space. So, there is an artificial seam between the communication space and task space. This is the type of impact of remote communication technology that needs to be predicted through communication models.

In 1977, psychologists Lynn Hasher and David Goldstein asked a group of college students how certain they were that sixty general-knowledge trivia-like statements were either true or false. The students were asked to evaluate the sixty statements three times, at two-week intervals. Crucially, only twenty of the statements were repeated each time; the other forty were new. The researchers then compared the ‘truth-ratings’ of the repeated versus non-repeated statements. What they found was astonishing. Regardless of whether the statement was true or false, belief in the truth of the claim went up as a function of repetition. In other words, the more often you hear a statement, the more ‘true’ it sounds. This became known as the illusory truth effect.

The human body on the Earth’s surface experiences constant air pressure equal to 16-18 tons per square meter of its body surface. However, this pressure is not felt because external pressure is balanced by internal pressure in the lungs and air cavities of the body. During dives, in addition to atmospheric pressure, the pressure of the water also acts on the human body. When submerged underwater, to avoid feeling the pressure of the surrounding environment, it is necessary to maintain the condition of equal external and internal pressure. To achieve this, air or a breathing mixture is supplied to the diver under pressure equal to the pressure applied by the surrounding water. Water pressure increases proportionally with depth. It increases by 1 bar for every 10 meters. It follows that a diver at a depth of 10 meters experiences a pressure of 2 bar, and to stabilize pressure, the supply of a breathing mixture under a pressure of 2 atmospheres is required.

Researchers recently found that goldenrods that live in peaceful areas without much threat from predators will issue chemical alarm calls that are incredibly specific — comprehensible only to their close kin — on the rare occasion they are attacked. But goldenrods in more hostile territory signal to their neighbors using chemical phrases easily understood by all the goldenrod in the area, not just their biological kin. Instead of using coded whisper networks, these goldenrod broadcast the threat over loudspeaker, so to speak. It is the first time research has confirmed that these chemical communications are beneficial not only to the plant receiving them but also to the sender. When times are truly tough, you do not want to be left standing in a field alone. There will be no one to mate with, no one to help bring in pollinators.

Patterns such as infinite scroll, autoplaying videos, or requiring an account just to make a purchase all interfere with the user’s control over their own experience. From a sustainability perspective, many of these patterns encourage overconsumption of data and attention. Infinite scroll keeps loading new content whether the user wants it or not, increasing data usage and device processing. Autoplay forces media to load and play even for people who may never watch it. These choices consume more energy on both the user’s device and the servers delivering the content. Take the decision by a popular music streaming platform to replace static album artwork with short video loops by default. This change significantly increases data usage and battery consumption, while the option to disable it is buried deep in the settings. As a result, most users consume more resources unless they actively search for a way to opt out. It is important to acknowledge that web design always nudges behavior in some way. Showing consequences and highlighting options are all forms of influence. The ethical line is not whether nudging exists, but whether it is transparent, reversible, and aligned with the user’s interests. In many cases, the most responsible approach is to make the lower-impact option the default, while keeping alternatives clearly available. Defaults are powerful, and when chosen carefully, they can reduce environmental impact without removing user agency.
